comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 flags any comment that argues through abstract reasoning (general principles, logic, conceptual or impersonal generalization). Feature 1 flags any comment that cites a specific identifiable real-world example (event, person, case, study). Feature 1 explicitly excludes purely abstract reasoning. A comment can satisfy one without the other, and each spec says abstract reasoning is judged independently of anecdotes. The source column, dtype and null/empty rules match, but the extraction predicates differ.
